tools.description: Identify the Vidreno account this connection belongs to. Call this when the user asks which account is connected.

tools.name: list_videos
tools.description: List the user's hosted videos, newest first, with optional search and visibility filter. Returns public video ids to use with the other tools. Paginate with page/page_size. tools.name: get_video

tools.name: get_embed_code

tools.name: update_video
tools.description: Change a video's title, description, visibility (public/private), player colour or content category. Only the fields given are changed.

tools.name: delete_video
tools.description: Permanently delete a hosted video and its file. Irreversible: always confirm with the user first (name the video) and only then call with confirm set to true.

tools.name: get_analytics
tools.description: How the user's videos are doing: totals (videos, views, storage), the most viewed videos, the newest uploads and a daily views series for the last N days.

tools.name: start_video_upload
tools.description: Begin uploading a new video from the user's computer. tools.name: list_films
tools.description: List the user's films (On Demand: free to watch or buy/rent), most recently edited first, with optional search and status filter. Returns public film ids to use with the other film tools. Paginate with page/page_size.

tools.name: get_film
tools.description: Full details of one film: status (draft/published), how it is released (free to watch or buy/rent) and its prices, play count, metadata, main film and trailer state, credits (with credit_ids), the publish checklist and its public page link. Films cannot be embedded.

tools.name: create_film
tools.description: Create a new draft film from a title (optionally with its age_rating and content_descriptors), exactly as the Studio's add-film dialog does. tools.description: Take a film off its public page (back to draft). Viewers who already bought or rented it keep their access.

tools.name: add_film_credit

tools.name: remove_film_credit
tools.description: Remove one credit from a film's credit list by credit_id (from get_film). A pending invite for it stops working.

tools.name: reorder_film_credits
tools.description: Set the order of a film's credits: pass every credit_id of the film in the order they should appear.

tools.name: invite_film_credit

tools.name: update_film_credit

The credit keeps its id, position and, when only the role or name changes, its accepted or linked stat

tools.name: convert_legacy_credits
tools.description: Turn a film's plain director and cast text lines into credit rows (Director for the director line, Actor for each comma-separated cast name), appended after the existing credits, and clear the lines — the film editor's convert button. Nothing is linked or invited; use update_film_credit afterwards.

tools.name: start_film_upload

tools.name: update_season
tools.description: Change a season's title, synopsis, buy/rent price (US cents, minimum $1.00, null removes) or rental window. Only the fields given change; the same validation as the series editor applies. The season's poster is added in the film editor.

tools.name: remove_season
tools.description: Delete a season with all its episodes and their videos; the seasons after it are renumbered. Refused while the season or any of its episodes has been sold or is in a checkout (unpublish_season instead). Confirm with the user before calling it.

tools.name: reorder_seasons
tools.description: Set the order of a series' seasons: every season id exactly once, first to last; they are renumbered 1, 2, 3…

tools.name: publish_season
tools.description: Make a season live on the series page. tools.name: unpublish_season
tools.description: Take a season off the series page (back to draft); its episodes keep their own status and show again when the season is republished. A published series left with no watchable episode returns to draft. Buyers keep their access.

tools.name: add_episode
tools.description: Add an episode to a season, numbered after the last one, as a draft with no video. Title, synopsis, runtime and a buy/rent price for this episode alone are optional. tools.name: update_episode
tools.description: Change an episode's title, synopsis, runtime, buy/rent price (US cents, minimum $1.00, null removes) or rental window. Only the fields given change; the same validation as the series editor applies. The video is replaced with start_film_upload (asset: episode), never here.

tools.name: remove_episode
tools.description: Delete an episode and its video; the episodes after it in the season are renumbered. Refused while the episode has been sold or is in a checkout (unpublish_episode instead). Confirm with the user before calling it.

tools.name: reorder_episodes
tools.description: Set the order of a season's episodes: every episode id of that season exactly once, first to last; they are renumbered 1, 2, 3… Episodes do not move between seasons.

tools.name: publish_episode
tools.description: Make an episode watchable on the series page. Refused, with the editor's message, until its video is ready (start_film_upload with asset: episode) and its season is published (publish_season). The first published, playable episode is what lets the series itself publish (publish_film).

tools.name: unpublish_episode
tools.description: Take an episode off the series page (back to draft). A published series left with no watchable episode returns to draft. Buyers keep their access.

Also says whether the user can post one (the filmmaker-profile requirements and the cap on live pro

tools.description: Apply to an open role as the user, with their filmmaker profile as the application (the owner sees the public profile card), an optional note and up to 3 links. findings.title: Description issues instructions to the model
findings.detail: Description of "remove_season" contains imperative instructions directed at the AI assistant rather than describing the tool. This is the core tool-poisoning technique.

findings.remediation: Treat the server as untrusted; the model may obey embedded instructions.

findings.title: Lethal trifecta: untrusted input + private data + external sink
findings.detail: Server "mcp" exposes tools that together enable an exfiltration flow. Untrusted content: list_videos, get_video, get_embed_code, start_video_upload, get_upload_status, publish_film, add_film_credit, update_film_credit, update_filmmaker_profile, list_projects, publish_project, list_project_applications, list_my_applications, withdraw_application · Private data: get_video, update_video, delete_video, start_video_upload, upload_video_from_chat, get_upload_status, create_film, publish_film, start_film_upload, create_project, update_project · Public sink: list_videos, get_video, get_embed_code, start_video_upload, upload_video_from_chat, get_upload_status, get_film, create_film, update_film, publish_film, add_film_credit, invite_film_credit, update_film_credit, start_film_upload, publish_season, publish_episode, get_earnings, list_projects, get_project, update_project, publish_project, add_project_role, send_application_message · Destructive: delete_video, remove_film_credit, remove_season, remove_episode, update_project, remove_project_role, search_open_roles.

evidence.snippet: Untrusted content: list_videos, get_video, get_embed_code, start_video_upload, get_upload_status, publish_film, add_film_credit, update_film_credit, update_filmmaker_profile, list_projects, publish_project, list_project_applications, list_my_applications, withdraw_application · Private data: get_video, update_video, delete_video, start_video_upload, upload_video_from_chat, get_upload_status, create_film, publish_film, start_film_upload, create_project, update_project · Public sink: list_videos, get_video, get_embed_code, start_video_upload, upload_video_from_chat, get_upload_status, get_film, create_film, update_film, publish_film, add_film_credit, invite_film_credit, update_film_credit, start_film_upload, publish_season, publish_episode, get_earnings, list_projects, get_project, update_project, publish_project, add_project_role, send_application_message · Destructive: delete_video, remove_film_credit, remove_season, remove_episode, update_project, remove_project_role, search_open_roles

findings.remediation: Do not co-install these capabilities under one trust boundary; an injected comment/email can steer the model to exfiltrate via the sink tool.
